content.short: Discover NFT Planets, Land, and Creatures in the Space Tokens Metaverse to Breed, Mine, and Craft the next generation of NFTs.
content.description:
Want to discover completely unique planetary NFTs throughout the galaxy that let you launch survey missions for land NFTs, discover life for Creature NFTs, and unearth the mineral NFTs that lie within? The Space Tokens Metaverse is a Cardano NFT game that lets you do all of these things and more.

Use QUID the ‘Quasi Interplanetary Universal Denomination’ token to fund your space exploration missions and earn rewards by being an active member of the community.

Become a land baron by surveying the whole system. Land NFTs let you own more pieces of the planets you discover. From the moment a Land NFT is minted, it starts accruing QUID rewards that you can claim. Whoever owns the Planet that a piece of land is from also earns rewards. There are many ways to play and earn in the Space Tokens metaverse.

Breed the Creature NFTs you discover to create completely new creature variants that will help you on your exploration missions. Each Creature has a unique set of personality stats that help or hinder the taming of other creatures you meet along the way. With over 50+ creature types and an infinite amount of variations, you’ll always be meeting something new on your missions.

Mine your Land NFTs for minerals and materials that can be used to craft items and spaceship components. You’ll be needing a lot of these material NFTs so you better start your mineral mission planning today.

The first galaxy of planetary NFTs is now live at SpaceTokens.io. 26 types of uniquely generated planets with a max of 25,000 planets available. Keep track of your discoveries from the My Expeditions page and show off each of your NFTs by sharing your discovery permalinks all over the internet.

This is only a small taste of what’s to come, so start discovering planets today and join in on the fun as we build out the Space Tokens Metaverse.
